;Disasters and accidents
*[[2017 Bangladesh landslide]]
**At least 134 people are dead and dozens are missing in landslides caused by days of heavy [[monsoon]]al rain in [[Bangladesh]]. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/dozens-killed-bangladesh-landslides-heavy-rain-170613081924125.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-40257913 (BBC)] [http://www.thestar.com.my/news/regional/2017/06/13/heavy-rains-kill-at-least-35-in-bangladesh/ (AFP via ''The Star'')]

;International relations
*[[Qatar–United States relations]]
**[[Dana Shell Smith]] announces she is resigning as [[United States Ambassador to Qatar]] amid [[2017 Qatar diplomatic crisis|regional tensions]] over [[Qatar]]'s alleged support for terrorist groups. [https://nypost.com/2017/06/13/us-ambassador-to-qatar-steps-down-amid-gulf-crisis/ (''New York Post'')]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**After over a year in [[North Korea|North Korean]] prison, the government releases the one-year [[coma]]tose [[Otto Warmbier]] after negotiations from the [[United States Department of State]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-pacific-40264468 (BBC)]
*[[North Korean defectors]]
**A [[North Korea]]n soldier crosses the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]] (DMZ) and defects to [[South Korea]], the first since September 2016. [http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2017/06/13/0200000000AEN20170613011700315.html (Yonhap)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Germany]]
**A shooting occurs at a local train station in the [[Unterföhring]] suburb of [[Munich]], [[Germany]]. The assailant shot a police officer in the head; she is in critical condition. Backup police engaged in a shootout where the suspect and two bystanders were injured. Police do not believe this is a terrorist attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-security-munich-idUSKBN1940UH (Reuters)] [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/shooting-munich-germany-train-station-after-cop-s-gun-grabbed-n771381 (NBC News)]
*[[2017 Georgia prison escape]]
**Two [[Baldwin State Prison]] inmates, Donnie Russell Rowe and Ricky Dubose, escape from a [[prisoner transport vehicle]] on [[Georgia State Route 16]] after overpowering and killing two police officers. The prisoners then carjacked a passing [[Honda Civic]] and fled towards [[Eatonton, Georgia]], according to officials. [http://abcnews.go.com/US/georgia-correctional-officers-killed-inmates-run/story?id=48003507 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the Republic of Ireland]]
**Irish [[Taoiseach]] [[Enda Kenny]] makes his farewell address to [[Dáil Éireann]], and will submit his resignation to [[President of Ireland|President]] [[Michael D. Higgins]] after six years in office. It is expected that his successor, [[Leo Varadkar]], will be elected by the Dáil to succeed him tomorrow. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2017/0613/882267-enda-kenny/ (RTÉ)]
